title: Blasphemy Against the Holy Spirit
definition: Blasphemy against the Holy Spirit is the hardened and willful attribution of the Spirit's clear work to evil in rejection of Christ.
summary: Jesus warned about a hardened rejection of the Spirit's testimony to Him.
christFocus: The Spirit bears witness to Christ, and rejecting that testimony with hardened hostility is spiritually deadly.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus warned about blasphemy against the Holy Spirit when religious leaders attributed His Spirit-empowered works to Satan. This was not a tender conscience worried about sin; it was hardened opposition to clear light.

This doctrine should be handled carefully. Many fearful believers worry they have committed this sin precisely because they are sensitive to sin.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many tender believers are tormented by fear over this doctrine, while hardened people ignore the warning. This doctrine matters because it must be explained with both seriousness and pastoral care.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: If you are grieved over sin and desire Christ, run to Him. Do not harden your heart against the Spirit's testimony. Respond to conviction with repentance and faith.
